title: GitPress theme manifest (theme.json)
description: Lives at the root of a theme package. Declares which GitPress spec version the theme implements and which options it accepts.

specVersion.description: GitPress theme spec version this theme implements.

engine.description: Build engine. Spec v1 defines only 'astro': the theme is an Astro project whose build command is `astro build`.

preview.description: Relative path to a preview image inside the theme package.

configSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describing theme.config in gitpress.json. Themes must apply defaults for absent options so old sites keep building after theme updates. This is also what platforms render as the theme's settings form: string properties with format "color" render as a color picker, string properties with "enum" render as a select, boolean properties render as a toggle, and everything else falls back to a text/number input.
